name: EditEngine
summary: Shopify bulk product editor (by Profitonium): filter products by collection, tag, vendor or status, then change prices, titles, tags, inventory, SEO fields and metafields in one run, with a preview first, scheduled runs for sales and an undo history. Plans are gated on products per task.
best_for: Shopify merchants with hundreds or thousands of products who change prices, tags, SEO fields or metafields in bulk and want a preview and an undo before anything goes live
skip_if: you only edit a handful of products at a time, which Shopify's own bulk editor already covers, or you are not comfortable granting an app broad access to your store data
honest_knock: Undo covers supported in-app edits only: deletes are permanent, and a spreadsheet import is only reversible if you kept the original export yourself. Percentage price changes stack: running the same edit twice applies it twice. The developer's terms give no refunds for partial billing periods, and the app asks for wide access to the store, including products, inventory, orders and customers.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Basic · per month, per store per 30 days on the Shopify App Store listing, billed in USD
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-26 on the EditEngine listing in the Shopify App Store; the listing says all charges are billed in USD, every 30 days) EditEngine has a free plan and three paid plans, and every plan allows unlimited bulk edit, import and export tasks. What changes is how many products and collections one task may touch. Free: 100 products and 5 collections per task, with undo and unlimited Import Advanced. Basic: $9.99 a month or $99.99 a year, 500 products and 10 collections per task, plus metafields export. Standard: $19.99 a month or $199.99 a year, 10,000 products and 100 collections per task, and scheduled bulk edits. Pro: $49.99 a month or $499.99 a year, unlimited products and collections per task. The annual prices save 17%. Partner development stores get unlimited use for free. An optional Backup add-on is listed as $6.99 to $59.99 a month; the listing does not break that range down.

compare_with.name: Shopify's built-in bulk editor
compare_with.why: the bulk editor in Shopify Admin costs nothing extra and lets you edit selected products in a spreadsheet view. EditEngine has to earn its price with rule-based changes across filtered products, a preview of every change, scheduled runs for sales and launches, CSV and XLSX import, and an undo history
